refnamediv.refpurpose: Check whether the KafkaConsumer has finished closing

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public boolRdKafka\KafkaConsumer::isClosed
Returns whether librdkafka has finished closing the consumer after RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::closeAsync. It does not mean that the consumer has been released: call RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::close for that.
Once the consumer group has closed, RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::getRebalanceProtocol returns an empty string. Topics and queues obtained from the consumer stay valid until RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::close.
Requires librdkafka 1.9.0 or later. The method does not exist when the extension is built with an older version.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns &true; once the consumer has closed, &false; otherwise.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws an Exception after RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::close has released the consumer.
